paragraphs: The X4 xDrive35d was part of the first-generation (F26) X4 range, produced from 2014 to 2018. It uses the N57 — a 3.0-litre straight-six diesel featuring a tri-turbo setup that was distinctive to this top-of-the-range diesel variant. The xDrive35d was the most powerful diesel option in the F26 line-up, positioned above the xDrive30d and xDrive20d in the X4's performance hierarchy. The X4 xDrive35d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
